style: Art style: premium 2D animation for a high-budget preschool TV series. images.name: pups-sheet
images.prompt: A character lineup sheet on a fully transparent background: six different puppies of one original rescue team, in 2 rows of 3. Each puppy is full-body, sitting, facing the viewer, happy with an open-mouth smile, and has a soft contact shadow. Leave wide empty space between the puppies: they must not touch or overlap, and nothing may be cut off at the edges. The first puppy (Pilpel) must match the reference image exactly. 1) top-left: Pilpel, a corgi firefighter: ginger-orange fur with cream muzzle, chest and paws, big upright pointy ears, red firefighter helmet with a small gold shield with a flame, red rescue vest with yellow reflective stripes and a round white patch with a red flame. 2) top-middle: Dubi, a beagle police officer: tan, white and brown fur, long floppy brown ears, blue police cap with a gold star, blue vest with a round white patch with a gold star. 3) top-right: Anani, a fluffy white samoyed pilot girl: very fluffy white fur, small pointy ears, purple aviator cap with light-blue goggles pushed up on the forehead, purple vest with a round white patch with small wings, a white scarf. 4) bottom-left: Bloki, a black-and-white border collie builder: black fur with white face stripe, white muzzle, chest and paws, semi-folded ears, yellow hard hat, yellow vest with a silver reflective stripe and a round white patch with a hammer. 5) bottom-middle: Gali, a gray schnauzer lifeguard girl: silver-gray fur with bushy white eyebrows and a white beard, small folded ears, turquoise sporty cap, turquoise vest with a round white patch with an orange life ring, an orange whistle on a cord. 6) bottom-right: Lulu, an apricot poodle veterinarian girl: curly apricot fur with a curly topknot and curly ears, pink headband with a round silver doctor's head mirror, pink vest with a round white patch with a pink heart, a stethoscope around the neck.

images.name: captain
images.prompt: One original character, full body, standing, facing the viewer, on a fully transparent background, in the same art style as the reference image: Captain Ori, a cheerful 9-year-old boy who leads the puppy rescue team from a lighthouse. images.name: vehicles

Chunky, rounded, toy-like proportions. Leave wide empty space between the objects: they must not touch or overlap, and nothing may be cut off at the edges.
